title: Measured effects of the four-day workweek trial
geography: Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, UK, US (141 companies)

source.name: Multi-country four-day workweek trial (141 companies, 2,896 employees)
source.publisher: Boston College researchers, published in Nature Human Behaviour

notes: Reported outcomes of the 2025 trial: burnout symptoms fell 71% on average, and some participating companies saw productivity surge by as much as 40%, without cutting output.
